Author: Saagi
Name: Veela's Achievement Ledger
Description: Use /val to track achievements, open native Achievement entries, and passively cache observed progress.
Punchline: Track achievements with native Achievement-window assisted refreshes.
TestingChangelog: Testing-only custom-repo build: native Achievement update-open pacing now uses a 6 second minimum lockout with the existing 15 second maximum. Closed-window update actions show Waiting for data for the 6-15s adaptive window; already-open window update actions show Request cooldown for 6s. Hidden/non-manually-viewable achievement filtering remains in place.
